original_test_intent: Verify the BMC Preserve configuration workflow: selected items or Check All can be saved, the resulting selection is accurately represented on the Factory Default page, and those settings are protected according to the approved preservation semantics when the separately governed default operation occurs.
original_method: Select the unique row; identify BMC/SUT/firmware and enumerate every selectable Preserve item with current value; capture the pre-selection state; an authorized operator selects the approved subset or Check All and saves once; reopen Preserve and Factory Default pages to verify the exact selection persisted; if criteria require actual preservation across Factory Default, link to the separately approved row-2211 reset sequence rather than injecting an unapproved reset into this five-minute configuration case; compare the selected values afterward and restore the approved selection policy.
manual_activity: An authorized WebUI operator chooses the approved Preserve items, verifies the visual selection on both pages and owns any separately approved Factory Default operation and recovery.
required_inputs: BMC/SUT/firmware and complete selectable Preserve-item inventory
Approved selected-item or Check-All matrix and expected saved representation on Factory Default page
Authoritative meaning of preserved values and whether actual Factory Default execution belongs to this row or row 2211
Configuration backup, final selection policy, credentials/session protection and recovery path
safety_requirements: Back up current preserve policy and affected configuration before saving changes
Verify exact BMC and protect QR-free screenshots/secrets/session data
Do not assume or issue `ResetType=PreserveSettings`; the source procedure contains no reset
Preserve logs and audit events rather than clearing them
If a reset is separately approved, execute it only under row-2211 one-shot gates; never retry automatically
agent_execution_scope: Validate identity, item matrix, WebUI workflow, backup and final-policy approval
Collect read-only pre-state and organize timestamped screenshots/export after Save
Assist with comparison but leave WebUI choice and any separate factory reset to authorized operator
Do not add a reset, choose items, expose credentials, clear logs, retry state changes or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve selection-only versus reset-inclusive scope and relationship to row 2211
Approve Preserve item/value matrix, displayed representation and final policy
Review selection and any linked post-reset evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the BMC WebUI to select the approved items and Save, then reopen Preserve and Factory Default pages and capture the exact selection. Execute Factory Default only through the separately approved row-2211 workflow if engineering requires it.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record a complete item/value matrix around the WebUI Save action and link any destructive post-default validation to row 2211 under its own approval and recovery gates.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure only selects items and saves, while Criteria 2 requires that selected items not return to defaults, which normally needs an actual Factory Default event. DeepSeek further injects an unsupported reset action. The scope must be resolved without changing Master or duplicating row 2211.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Preserve configuration objective is clear. Engineering can define whether destructive validation is linked from row 2211 and supply the item/value oracle; static review therefore completes with execution gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2212 Wistron-BMC-01062-V002: decide whether it ends after Select/Check All/Save plus Factory Default-page display or also requires actual preservation across the separately governed row-2211 reset; approve the full Preserve item/current-value/selected-state matrix, meaning of 'cannot be restored/changed back', WebUI versus supported API, final policy/cleanup, configuration backup, credential handling, and—if reset is included—the one-shot approval/readiness/recovery contract.

review_improvement: Prevents an unsupported destructive reset from replacing the specified WebUI selection test and gives the implied post-default criterion an explicit linked-scope decision and evidence model.
independent_technical_reasoning: Saving a preservation policy and exercising that policy are different state transitions. The five-minute Procedure covers only the first, whereas Criteria 2 appears to require the second. Injecting a generic reset would expand scope, duplicate row 2211 and add destructive risk. The correct static review preserves both source statements, records their conflict and requires an engineer to define whether evidence is linked across the two rows. Exact item selection matters because Check All can preserve credentials or network state that the project intended to reset.
